I note that the Job interview and Collaborative art workshop overlap in time. To avoid penalties, I will likely skip or shorten one of these. What are your attendance plans for these overlapping meetings?

For the Study group, I plan to attend fully [8, 10) to coordinate with all participants including you, Avery, and Taylor. Looking forward to hearing your plans to coordinate attendance for these sessions.
